# Nycta

<img src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fedetomassini/nycta-vscode/main/assets/icon.png" alt="Nycta's lavender moth" width="112" height="112">

Nycta is a collection of color themes for Visual Studio Code. Its first theme,
**Nycta Dark**, pairs a near-black `#080808` editor and terminal with soft
lavender types, pink keywords, and green strings. It supports both TextMate
scopes and semantic highlighting.

## Install from a VSIX

Download the `.vsix` from a **`nycta-vsc: v…`** release on GitHub.

Open the Extensions view, choose **… → Install from VSIX…**, and select the
package. In **Preferences: Color Theme**, choose **Nycta Dark**.

## Build locally

To preview changes, open the repository in VS Code and press **F5**. In the
Extension Development Host window, select **Preferences: Color Theme → Nycta Dark**.

With Node.js 22+ installed, run `npm run package` from the repository root to
build the VSIX. The theme itself has no runtime dependencies.

For bug reports, theme suggestions, and pull requests, see the
[contribution guide](https://github.com/fedetomassini/nycta-vscode/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md).
